## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (80%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive carcinoma (20%) stays in the 90% conformal set [F1], with simulated inferior margin involvement (215 um) [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 80%, Invasive 20%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Favors InSitu; Invasive remains plausible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage, alpha=0.1) | Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100% OOD percentile (10 tiles) [F6] | Acceptable quality despite JPEG degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones match top call |
| Similar cases | 1/5 InSitu, 4/5 Invasive (20% agreement) [F5] | Nearest neighbors mostly labeled Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 4, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (1.14; +0.76 contribution; 19/20 AI spot-check) [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.83; +0.73 contribution; caption-inconsistent; 18/20 spot-check) [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 8) · context · Above-typical score (1.27; descriptive only; 8/20 AI spot-check) [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.17; +0.65 contribution; 0/20 AI spot-check) · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.08; +0.46 contribution; 20/20 AI spot-check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal_lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Stromal invasion exists in high-risk regions 5 (0.41) or 2 (0.25), matching 4/5 Invasive neighbors (BACH_0310, 76% similarity).
- Simulated frozen-section and severity-3 JPEG artifacts distort tissue architecture or trigger a false inferior margin call.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 2, 6**: Highest classifier invasive-risk scores (0.41, 0.25, 0.11); inspect closely for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 3, 4, 10**: Top invasion-concept scores; check duct borders amidst dense lymphocytes in regions 4, 8.
3. **Region 7**: Verify scarce tubules (-0.83) and inspect the inferior margin (215 um positive at y=1280).
